complexity.title: Every hard public problem is several problems at once.
body: A fiscal squeeze shows up in schools. A heatwave shows up in the power grid. A weak institution turns a good budget into a stalled project.
The first job is to see how these pressures connect. Select a system to see what it is tied to.

evidence.title: Start with what can be checked.
body: We build the evidence base from five kinds of material and keep each one traceable to its source.
Layering them lets us test one against another, so a finding does not rest on a single number or a single interview.

insight.title: Patterns become findings when they survive scrutiny.
body: Two questions come up in almost every engagement: did it work, and is it worth it? These diagrams show how we frame each one.

policy.title: Findings become choices.
body: Evidence rarely points to a single answer. We set out the options, what each costs and risks, who has to act, and what implementation will take, so the decision is made with open eyes.

practice.title: A decision only matters once it reaches a service.
body: Policy moves through ministries, agencies and municipalities into budgets, rules and front-line services. We help design the delivery arrangements, skills and monitoring that let a change hold.

impact.title: Public value is something you can check later.
body: We agree how success will be recognised before the work starts, so results can be tracked, learned from and reported honestly.

domains.title: Climate Action, ESG & Circular Economy
domains.short: Green transition, ESG strategy and circular-economy policy and practice.
intro: IP3 helps governments, businesses and financial institutions move from climate and sustainability ambition to action. We work where transition ambition meets financing, regulation and day-to-day operations.

The work covers green-transition policy and governance, ESG strategy and reporting, circular-economy pathways, biodiversity, and climate adaptation and resilience. We deliver it through feasibility studies, policy reviews, sector strategies and practical interventions fitted to local and global contexts.
The aim is growth that takes environmental constraints and social equity into account. We align the work with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the Paris Agreement targets.
questions: What prevents investment in a green transition?

How can ESG move from reporting to operational strategy?
How should climate, transition and financial risks change investment priorities?
What financing mechanisms make the transition viable?

The work covers institutional diagnostics and operating models, regulatory design, data governance and interoperability, digital public infrastructure, and the capability needed to run them. We put the same questions to every digital tool: who owns it, who might be excluded, and whether the institution can maintain it.

Public policy innovation and action research is a method that runs across IP3 work, not a separate domain. It combines policy research and analysis, stakeholder collaboration and policy experimentation, so that reforms are tested before they are scaled.

method.heading: Reform is a movement, not a moment.
intro: Complex challenges rarely fail for want of another recommendation. They fail when evidence is disconnected from decisions, strategy from financing, technology from users, and reform from the institutions that must own it.

IP3 works through six movements, and each ends in a named output. Solutions are understood before they are designed, tested before they are scaled, implemented with the people who must operate them, and improved through evidence.

movements.title: Sense & Diagnose
movements.text: Understand the system before treating the symptom. A visible problem is rarely the whole problem. We run a current-state diagnostic of how policies, institutions, incentives, markets, people, technology, finance, infrastructure, data and behaviours interact. It separates what drives the problem from what is only a symptom, and shows where intervention has the most leverage.

movements.title: Build Intelligence
movements.text: Turn information into decision intelligence. Not every evidence gap needs another large study. We identify what must be known to change a decision, combine existing evidence with new primary research where it is needed, and link quantitative analysis to institutional, behavioural and user insight. The evidence is then translated into a practical target state.

movements.title: Co-Design & Test
movements.text: Turn evidence into something that can operate. Policies, programmes, operating models, digital systems, regulations, financial mechanisms and services are designed with the institutions and people who must use them. They are then prototyped and tested before anyone commits institutional resources.

movements.title: Mobilise
movements.text: A good design cannot implement itself. Mobilisation is broader than financing. It means aligning the mandate, leadership, stakeholders, people, capabilities, technology, data, financing and implementation resources needed to move from design into operation. We do this jointly with the finance, policy, IT, programme and leadership teams of the client, not through a downstream consultant.

movements.title: Implement & Transfer
movements.text: Implementation is part of consulting, not what happens after consulting. We work alongside clients as strategy becomes operating reality, and we treat change management and stakeholder engagement as implementation disciplines, not communication exercises. The aim is institutional capability, transferred deliberately as the work proceeds, not consultant dependency.
movements.output: Operational Delivery System & Capability Transfer Plan

movements.title: Learn & Scale
movements.text: Measure in time to change something. Our MERLA approach (monitoring, evaluation, research, learning and adaptation) asks what decision-makers need to know while implementation is still under way. Decision thresholds and feedback loops are agreed before implementation starts, so evidence can change the programme rather than only report on it. Scale is earned, not assumed: it follows evidence on effectiveness, adoption, affordability and institutional capacity.

principles.title: Evidence before assumption
principles.text: We generate and use evidence to change decisions. Research is the start of the work, not automatically its final product.

principles.title: Systems before symptoms
principles.text: Connected problems need connected responses. We examine how policies, institutions, finance, markets, technology, users and implementation relate to one another before we define the intervention.

principles.title: Co-creation, not prescription
principles.text: We bring together government, markets, development partners, researchers, implementers, technology teams and communities. Solutions are stronger when the people who must operate and experience them help shape them.

principles.title: Test before scale
principles.text: Strategies are useful when they survive contact with reality. Where uncertainty makes early scale risky, we prototype, pilot, test and iterate.

principles.title: Implementation alongside strategy
principles.text: Policy, research, finance, digital design, programme management and evaluation should not become disconnected workstreams. We work across the value chain, from diagnosis to implementation and adaptation.

principles.title: Capability beyond the assignment
principles.text: The strongest sign of success is not that IP3 remains indispensable. It is that the client has stronger systems, people, data and capacity to keep improving after the engagement.

portfolio.title: Increasing investment in early warning systems for climate and disaster resilience
portfolio.place: Bangladesh, Cambodia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Lao PDR, Maldives, Mongolia, Nepal, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan
portfolio.summary: Design and start-up of a multi-hazard early warning facility that helps ten ADB member countries identify, prepare and finance early warning investments at scale.
portfolio.challenge: Early warning systems save lives and assets, but across Asia they are under-funded and fragmented: hazard monitoring, alerting and last-mile dissemination sit with different agencies, and few countries have investment-ready proposals. ADB set out to create a facility that turns that gap into a pipeline of financeable projects.
approach: Rapid diagnostics of hydromet, hazard and alerting gaps, with stakeholder mapping and country consultations.
A facility blueprint covering governance, financing instruments, eligibility and the safeguards interface.
Investment concept notes and screening templates, with pilot concepts prioritised for Bangladesh and Cambodia.
Costing toolkits and cost-benefit models, budget notes and procurement plans.
Standard operating procedures and technical specifications for multi-channel alerting: cell broadcast, SMS, voice, FM radio and community channels.
A monitoring and evaluation logframe aligned with the Sendai Framework and SDG 13.
Financial evaluation packages, WACC benchmarks and operation and maintenance sustainability over asset life.
Economic and financial analysis chapters for three country investment frameworks, and donor-ready proposal material.

about.heading: Translating policy intelligence into systems that work
about.lead: IP3 Consulting — the Institute for Public Policy and Practice — is a translational policy studio and systems integrator helping governments, development partners, businesses and institutions turn complex policy ambitions into implementable, scalable solutions.
body: We work where policy, economics, climate, institutions, data, technology, education and implementation intersect. We combine rigorous research and policy intelligence with systems thinking, digital architecture, locally grounded expertise and hands-on implementation support, so that clients can move from understanding a problem to designing, testing, delivering and improving the solution.

IP3 does not stop at diagnosis, recommendations or a report. We work across the policy and management advisory value chain: from market and institutional diagnostics, empirical research and policy co-design, through experimentation and implementation support, to monitoring, learning, adaptation and scale.

Institutional challenges rarely arrive one at a time. Climate exposure interacts with financing constraints, digital transformation reshapes service delivery, and education outcomes depend on institutional capability. We combine global expertise with Global South intelligence, drawing on economists, policy specialists, systems thinkers, sector experts, data professionals and digital strategists, to build solutions that are globally informed, locally workable and designed for implementation.

IP3 runs on what we call the Dynamic Network Model. It connects in-house capability with economists, academics, policy specialists, development practitioners, industry experts and data and technology professionals, assembled around the specific problem.
We translate intelligence into architecture — and architecture into impact.

principles.title: From poly-crisis to poly-solutions
principles.text: Connected problems need connected solutions. We map the relationships between systems before deciding where intervention has the most leverage, then design integrated, evidence-led and co-created responses around how the problem actually behaves.

principles.title: Translation, not theory
principles.text: Evidence matters when it changes what institutions can do. Research is where an engagement begins: evidence becomes policy intelligence, then systems and delivery architecture, then implementation, and implementation experience feeds back into learning.

principles.title: Thinking that ships
principles.text: Policy architectures, diagnostics, research reports, implementation frameworks and digital solutions are built to help decision-makers act, not only understand. Insight should end in a decision, a design, a tested intervention or a clearer path to implementation.

principles.title: End-to-end expertise
principles.text: Strategy, research, implementation, data and evaluation are integrated, not split across disconnected advisory teams. Depending on the assignment, we work from diagnostics and policy research through data modelling, stakeholder engagement, co-design, pilots, implementation support, digital systems, MERLA and capability building, to learning and scale.

principles.title: A convenor between worlds
principles.text: We work between communities that often work separately: policy and practice, government and markets, research and implementation, technology and institutions, international standards and local realities. A Global South focus means starting with context and connecting it to global knowledge, not localising an imported framework.

audiences.name: Development partners and multilateral development banks

about.vision: We envision a future in which governments, institutions, businesses and communities have the policies, capabilities, data, partnerships and institutional resilience needed to navigate complexity and create sustainable, equitable prosperity. Public policy should become more adaptive, more connected to implementation, and better at turning economic opportunity, technological change, social inclusion and environmental responsibility into durable improvements in institutions and in people's lives.

We develop solutions that are grounded in context and built to last beyond the life of an assignment.

sections.title: What we collect
text: When you send an enquiry we collect your name, email address, organisation, the topic you choose and the message you write.
When you book a conversation we also collect the date and time you choose.
To help us spot spam, the server also records the network address and browser details that arrive with an enquiry.
We do not ask for anything else, and the site does not require you to create an account.
If you switch the 3D scene on or off, your choice is remembered in your own browser. It is not sent to us.

sections.title: What we do not do
text: This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies, and it does not run third-party analytics.
We do not sell or share your details for marketing.

sections.title: How we use it
text: We use what you send only to reply to you, to arrange the conversation you asked for, and to keep a record of the enquiry.
When we confirm a conversation, we send you a link to an online meeting room on Jitsi Meet, a free video service that needs no account. The room name is unique to your booking.

sections.title: The Ask IP3 assistant
text: If you use the Ask IP3 assistant, your question and the conversation so far are sent to Anthropic, the company that provides the Claude AI model, to write the answer. The assistant answers only from the content of this website.
We do not store your questions or the answers, and the assistant cannot see anything else about you. Please do not type personal or confidential information into it.

sections.title: Who can see it, and for how long
text: Enquiries and bookings are stored in a database that IP3 controls. Only IP3's site administrators can see them, after signing in to a password-protected console.
We keep an enquiry for 60 days and then delete it automatically. A booking is deleted 60 days after the date of the conversation.
If you would like your enquiry corrected or deleted sooner, write to the email address on the contact page and we will do it.

about.heading: আমরা কারা
body: আইপিথ্রি কনসালটিং লিমিটেড, ইনস্টিটিউট ফর পাবলিক পলিসি অ্যান্ড প্র্যাকটিস, একটি স্বাধীন নীতি-গবেষণা ও পরামর্শক প্রতিষ্ঠান। নীতি, অর্থনীতি, জলবায়ু, প্রতিষ্ঠান, তথ্য, প্রযুক্তি ও শিক্ষা যেখানে একে অন্যের সঙ্গে মেশে, আমরা সেখানেই কাজ করি।

আমাদের কাজ প্রতিবেদন দিয়ে শেষ হয় না। সমস্যার বিশ্লেষণ থেকে শুরু করে নীতি-নকশা, পরীক্ষামূলক প্রয়োগ, বাস্তবায়ন সহায়তা, পরিবীক্ষণ ও শিক্ষণ পর্যন্ত আমরা প্রতিষ্ঠানের পাশে থাকি, যাতে সমাধান টেকসই হয় এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিজের সক্ষমতা গড়ে ওঠে।
বিশ্বব্যাংক, এশীয় উন্নয়ন ব্যাংক (এডিবি), ইউরোপীয় কমিশন ও সুইডিশ দূতাবাস (Sida)-সহ উন্নয়ন সহযোগী এবং বাংলাদেশ সরকারের বিভিন্ন মন্ত্রণালয় ও সংস্থার সঙ্গে আমরা কাজ করেছি।

work.summary: উত্তরণের ঝুঁকি মোকাবিলা এবং বাণিজ্য, ব্যবসা, অর্থায়ন ও বাজারের সুযোগ চিহ্নিত করতে ইউরোপীয় ইউনিয়নের জন্য বিশ্লেষণ (ইউরোপীয় কমিশন, ২০২০–২০২১)।

work.title: হ্যালো+ (HALOW+): পোশাকশ্রমিকদের স্বাস্থ্যসেবায় প্রবেশাধিকার
work.summary: পোশাকশ্রমিকদের জন্য স্বাস্থ্যসেবার বাজার গড়ে তোলা, কর্মপরিবেশ ও স্বাস্থ্যের উন্নতি এবং কারখানার উৎপাদনশীলতা বৃদ্ধির বহু-অংশীদার কর্মসূচি; পুরো অংশীদারত্বের পরিবীক্ষণ ও প্রভাব মূল্যায়ন (২০১৮–২০২০)।

approach.title: বুঝুন ও নির্ণয় করুন
approach.text: উপসর্গ নয়, পুরো ব্যবস্থাটি বুঝে সমস্যার মূল কারণ খুঁজে বের করা।

approach.title: জ্ঞান গড়ে তুলুন
approach.text: যে তথ্য সিদ্ধান্ত বদলায়, শুধু সেটিই সংগ্রহ ও বিশ্লেষণ করা।

approach.title: যৌথ নকশা ও পরীক্ষা
approach.text: যাঁরা ব্যবহার করবেন তাঁদের সঙ্গে নিয়ে নীতি ও কর্মসূচি নকশা করা এবং আগে পরীক্ষা করা।

approach.title: সমন্বয় ও সংগঠন
approach.text: বাস্তবায়নের জন্য নেতৃত্ব, অংশীজন, সক্ষমতা, প্রযুক্তি ও অর্থায়ন একসঙ্গে আনা।

approach.title: বাস্তবায়ন ও হস্তান্তর
approach.text: প্রতিষ্ঠানের পাশে থেকে বাস্তবায়ন এবং ধাপে ধাপে সক্ষমতা হস্তান্তর।

approach.title: শিক্ষা ও সম্প্রসারণ
approach.text: সময়মতো পরিমাপ, যাতে প্রমাণের ভিত্তিতে কর্মসূচি বদলানো ও সম্প্রসারণ করা যায়।

bangla.peopleLead: অর্থনীতিবিদ, নীতি-বিশেষজ্ঞ, আইনজীবী, শিক্ষা ও প্রযুক্তি বিশেষজ্ঞ এবং দেশ-বিদেশের বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের গবেষকদের নিয়ে আমাদের দল।
bangla.contactLead: আপনি কোন প্রশ্নের উত্তর খুঁজছেন, আমাদের জানান। আমরা কীভাবে সাহায্য করতে পারি, তা জানিয়ে উত্তর দেব। বাংলা বা ইংরেজি, যেকোনো ভাষায় লিখতে পারেন।
bangla.hours: রবিবার থেকে বৃহস্পতিবার, সকাল ৯টা থেকে সন্ধ্যা ৬টা
bangla.englishNote: এটি আমাদের ওয়েবসাইটের বাংলা সারসংক্ষেপ। কাজ, সেবা ও মানুষের পূর্ণ বিবরণ ইংরেজি পাতাগুলোতে দেওয়া আছে।
